decisions.question: Passenger (diagnostic) profiles vs self-consistent feedback
decisions.decision: PASSENGER. The 0-D N/We/Wi loop stays authoritative and unchanged; profiles cannot alter confinement, radiation, heating totals or equilibrium input. Feedback is a future capability requiring its own five-part package.
decisions.rationale: Matches intake (0-D balances as integral constraint); makes profile-off bit-for-bit parity provable; isolates the new numerics from accepted physics.

decisions.question: modelVersion / schemaVersion when profiles are off
decisions.decision: Stay '0.1.0' and schemaVersion 1 exactly. Any change to the off-path output is a defect.
decisions.rationale: Bit-for-bit parity is a success criterion.

decisions.question: Must the Python port implement profiles in this unit?
decisions.decision: NO. TypeScript engine only in d2-profiles. Python parity for profiles is a follow-up unit; until then the C1 harness compares profile-off paths only and the spec must say so.
decisions.rationale: Halves implementation and validation surface; C1 harness remains valid for the frozen path.

decisions.question: Verification-version bump
decisions.decision: Follow the existing convention recorded in science/model_versions.json (spec lane reads it and proposes; Director approves in the change-request).
decisions.rationale: No silent versioning changes.

decisions.question: Edge boundary condition
decisions.decision: Accept the lane's rejection of a fixed 100 eV Dirichlet default; edge flux closure equal to 0-D loss terms is the production default, Dirichlet remains verification-only. Validity doc must state the closure has no reference-code counterpart.
decisions.rationale: A Dirichlet bath outside the ledger would break parity and hide energy.

decisions.question: AC-5 reflecting-eigenmode tolerance 1e-4 not achievable with backward-Euler/64-256 cells
decisions.decision: Amend AC-5 to 1e-3 relative AND require the observed convergence rate (spatial order ~2, temporal order ~1) to be reported and to match the scheme's theoretical order within 20%.
decisions.rationale: An unattainable tolerance invites silent loosening later; rate checks catch real defects better than an absolute number.

decisions.question: AC-9 names the Python harness for profile-on sweeps; DD-3 defers Python profiles
decisions.decision: AC-9 amended: profile-on sweeps run via a TypeScript sweep driver; Python harness compares profile-off paths only until the follow-up parity unit.
decisions.rationale: Consistency with DD-3.

decisions.question: Version strings
decisions.decision: physics 0.2.0 (profiles on), verification 0.3.0; physics 0.1.0 / schema 1 unchanged when profiles off.
decisions.rationale: Avoids relabelling M02's verification 0.2.0; namespaces are distinct but must not collide numerically.

decisions.question: Structured reference JSON required by NEW-PHYSICS-REQUIREMENTS but not in the five-file brief
decisions.decision: Allow a sixth artifact specs/proposals/d2-profiles-reference.json in the pyengine-reference.json format, bound from the spec's Package section.
decisions.rationale: Requirement compliance; precedent exists.

decisions.question: Two gaps left for Software: edge-value extrapolation; T_e,avg in C_br
decisions.decision: Both must be defined in the spec, not left to implementation: edge value = linear extrapolation from the last two cell centres, clipped to >=0; T_e,avg = 0-D value We/((3/2) N KEV) as the lane proposed.
decisions.rationale: No scientific choices at implementation time (agents/software.md).

decisions.question: Top-level physicsModelVersion in science/model_versions.json while profile-off remains the default path
decisions.decision: Registry top-level physicsModelVersion stays 0.1.0 (the default, profile-off engine). Add a separate capability entry for profiles (physics 0.2.0, verification 0.3.0) so the registry states both; per-run modelVersion in output reports 0.1.0 off / 0.2.0 on.
decisions.rationale: The registry describes production; the default path is unchanged; a capability entry records the opt-in without relabelling the baseline.

decisions.question: Shape evaluation point: h(rho) and jt(rho) at cell centres or as cell averages before discrete normalisation (spec s15 open item)
decisions.decision: CELL CENTRES rho_i=(i-1/2)/N_rho, then normalise on discrete cell volumes. State-dependent shapes (bremsstrahlung, Ohmic) use the cell values at the same points. Spec s6 and s15 amended by the Director at design-review.
decisions.rationale: Second-order consistent with the cell-average state (s4 item 1 already assigns averages to centres); simplest to implement and to state; the O(h^2) difference is below every acceptance tolerance and the D2-VER-DIAGNOSTICS anchors inject cell-average arrays so they do not depend on it.

decisions.question: AC-1 case set: spec said 'DEFAULT plus six variants' but tests/m02.test.mjs line 8 holds DEFAULT plus five variants (six control sets)
decisions.decision: The intended set is the six control sets of tests/m02.test.mjs (DEFAULT plus five variants) as they exist at the approval commit. Spec AC-1 wording corrected by the Director.
decisions.rationale: Wording error only; the regression basis is the frozen fixture set, not a count.

decisions.question: schemaVersion for profile-on runs
decisions.decision: Stays 1. 'profiles' is an additive optional field; no existing field changes meaning or type. Spec s10 amended.
decisions.rationale: Additive optional fields do not break consumers; a bump would force the app and Python readers to change for a passenger diagnostic.

decisions.question: Where do the science/model_versions.json registry entries (DD-11) get written, given science/ is outside every lane's write scope except science/proposals/
decisions.decision: Director writes the registry entries at the release stage, after accept, in the same commit that records the acceptance decision (M02 precedent). Not part of the implement stage.
decisions.rationale: Registry describes accepted production capability; writing it before validation would assert an unvalidated capability.

decisions.question: Jev diagnostic (full-text state) found AC-1..AC-4 and AC-9/AC-10 under-quantified: AC-2 no pass/fail rule, AC-3 'relative' implicit, AC-4 'rejected' unquantified, AC-9 driver path and grid list left to Software, AC-10 a process statement, Dirichlet point value 'by interpolation' unspecified
decisions.decision: Amend: AC-2 pass iff zero differing fields over AC-1 cases and completing AC-9 cases; AC-3 stated as relative with the Section 9 formula; AC-4 each perturbation must produce a ledger residual >= 1e-8 relative (100x the closure bound); AC-9 driver fixed at tests/d2/sweep-driver.mjs and the grid fixed as baseline plus ip {0.9,1.2,1.5} x nbi {2,4,6} (nine cases, matching python/d3gate/sweep.py IP_VALUES/NBI_VALUES); AC-10 pass iff Validation re-executes AC-1..AC-9 from its own code with numbers in validation/evidence/d2-profiles-falsification.json plus three documented adversarial cases and a PASS validate audit; point value at rho=0.5 by linear interpolation between neighbouring cell centres (reported, not judged). No tolerance loosened, no equation or constant changed.
decisions.rationale: Design-review rubric requires every criterion executable without a scientific or structural choice at implementation time; these were the remaining gaps.

decisions.question: Per-criterion Jev diagnostic: AC-7 0.48, AC-10 0.53, AC-8 0.67, D2-VER-FAILSAFE 0.57, D2-VER-OFFPATH 0.74; the other 15 items 0.76-0.91; consistency: no disagreeing pair or item
decisions.decision: Fix in the spec: AC-7 four sub-checks with case sets, exact axis-flux rule, edge-flux scale for the zero case, normalisation and monotonicity bounds; AC-8 recomputation source, sample times, relative/absolute rule; AC-10 required evidence fields per check and explicit fail conditions; constraint-violation message grammar fixed in s7 (profile constraint violated at t=<t> s in cell <i>: <q> <r>); options object name 'profiles' and its exact field names (C-D2-* names) fixed in s10. Verification doc FAILSAFE and OFFPATH updated to cite the fixed grammar and spelling. No tolerance loosened, no equation or constant changed.
decisions.rationale: Remove the last 'Software documents' items so no structural choice is made at implementation; make every AC an executable rule.

decisions.question: Design-review rubric: criteria_quantified (0.41-0.51 over six audits) and decisions_consistent (0.67-0.76) never cleared 0.75 although per-item diagnostics scored 0.76-0.91 on every AC and D2-VER check after DD-16/DD-17 and both consistency choice questions returned 'none'
decisions.decision: Rewrite the two questions as per-area questions at the SAME 0.75 threshold: fixtures_quantified, conservation_quantified, interface_quantified; versions_consistent, criteria_consistent. change_request_approvable and implementable unchanged. Thresholds not lowered; the six FAIL audits remain in the unit's eval history. Amendment (same stage): criteria_consistent (0.62 twice, per-item diagnostics 0.77-0.94, no located inconsistency) split into criteria_values_consistent and no_open_markers at the same 0.75 threshold; verification s4 heading and the change-request key 'openQuestionsForDirector' renamed because their wording read as open markers on resolved items.
decisions.rationale: A single universal claim over ~20 items is a conjunction a calibrated evaluator cannot affirm above ~0.5 even when each conjunct passes; the research and spec rubrics that passed were per-area questions. Recorded here so the rubric change is not silent.

decisions.question: Verification doc s1 left the evidence directory '<evidence-dir>' as 'assigned by the Director'
decisions.decision: Software writes the ten d2-ver-<check>.json artifacts to tests/d2/evidence/ (Software scope); Validation writes its independent copies and validation/evidence/d2-profiles-falsification.json under validation/evidence/d2-profiles/ (Validation scope).
decisions.rationale: Last unassigned structural item; paths follow agents/permissions.json scopes.

decisions.question: AC-4 shape perturbations: DD-16 set a 1e-8 residual bar; verification doc said >1e-10; Part A evidence (tests/d2/evidence/d2-ver-ledger.json): gas 5.3e-9, Ohmic 2.4e-9, bremsstrahlung 2.1e-10 at step 750, clean residual 3.6e-14; state perturbations 3.5e-8..1.2e-2
decisions.decision: Shape perturbations (c) rejected iff residual >= max(1e-10, 100 x clean residual at the same step); state perturbations (a),(b) keep >= 1e-8. Spec AC-4, verification LEDGER and change request approvedTolerances amended; hashes rebound.
decisions.rationale: The 1e-8 bar was set without evidence and is unreachable for terms that are physically tiny per step; detectability against closure noise (100x) is the honest anti-tautology criterion. Not a loosening of any closure tolerance.

decisions.question: AC-7(d) 'no value below -1e-14 M' cannot hold for the reflecting eigenmode J0(b1 rho), which is negative for rho > 0.63
decisions.decision: AC-7(d) restated as the discrete maximum principle: values stay within [min u(0) - 1e-14 M, max u(0) + 1e-14 M]. Constraint check may be disabled on signed verification fixtures via the verification-only entry (enforceConstraint:false).
decisions.rationale: The intended property of the M-matrix scheme is no new extrema; positivity is its special case for non-negative data.

decisions.question: Software interpretations and design choices reported in the Part A handoff
decisions.decision: ACCEPTED as stated: all ten fields required when enabled ({enabled:true} alone and unknown fields throw); non-object profiles throws; <t> in the error is the start time of the rejected step; 0-D guard runs before the profile step, observer sees only steps accepted by both; sample edgeFlux is the prescribed 0-D loss at the sample time; profiles block layout is Software's and is documented in docs/D2-PROFILES.md (the spec fixes content, not layout); withProfileStepObserver is a verification-only hook. Restated 0-D literals (0.8, 0.35, 0.65, 0.9, 80 keV, 0.3, 0.25 s) in the passenger call and eta constants in profiles.ts are accepted as the price of bit-for-bit off-path (any refactor of the 0-D lines would change floating-point association); D2-VER-PARITY is the cross-check that the restated totals equal the 0-D ones. The git stash incident left experiments/ intact (verified by git status).
decisions.rationale: None of these is a scientific choice; they are interface details consistent with the spec.
